scope: English men’s football pyramid levels 1–5; regular league fixtures only.

source.dataDescription: Fixtures, full-time scores and, where present, half-time scores; no event or tracking statistics.

excludedSeasons.2019-20: Interrupted COVID season; not a complete common five-tier sample.
excludedSeasons.2020-21: National League regular season was incomplete.
excludedSeasons.2021-22: National League regular season source has only 506 of 552 scores.
excludedSeasons.2025-26: League One, League Two and National League source files are incomplete.

method.playoffs: Excluded by reading only regular-season matchday sections.
method.score: Full-time 90-minute result as recorded by the source; extra-time cup results are out of scope.
method.variance: Unbiased match-level sample variance with denominator n−1; season samples are pooled by match, not by season mean.
method.rounding: Aggregate values rounded to 4 decimal places; rates are fractions from 0 to 1.

limitations: This is an England top-five-level results sample, not all UK nations or the full English pyramid.
Results data supports goals and home/draw/away outcomes only; it cannot validate passes, shots, xG, possession, duels, tackles, saves, player ratings, or running distances.
These figures are offline validation references, not in-game caps, target quotas, or instructions to alter individual decisions.
League level and season strength differ; compare against the intended tier and inspect match-level distributions rather than forcing every game toward the pooled mean.
